How Our Process Works

  1. We inspect your roof and document every issue with photos.
  2. We walk you through repair or replacement options and pricing.
  3. Our crew completes the work and cleans up the site the same day.

Workmanship That Lasts

Every roof we install is built with manufacturer-approved materials and installed by our own trained crews, not day labor.

We inspect each project on completion so small problems never become leaks.

Storm Damage Restoration

Hail and wind can loosen shingles and open seams long before a leak appears inside the home.

We document storm damage for your insurance adjuster and handle repairs from tarping to full replacement.

Areas We Serve

We work throughout Mecklenburg County, including Charlotte, Matthews, Huntersville and Cornelius.

Frequently Asked Questions

How long does a roof replacement take?

Most residential replacements are finished in one to two days, depending on weather and roof size.

Do you help with insurance claims?

Yes. We meet with your adjuster and provide photo documentation of the damage we find.
